name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre’s journey into motorsport security was somewhat unconventional. After a stint in the Royal Canadian Mounted Police, where he specialized in protective services, he sought a career that combined his love for high-octane action with his meticulous approach to risk assessment. He was initially drawn to motorsport through his younger brother's involvement in amateur racing, and quickly identified a need for enhanced security protocols within smaller race teams. 

Jean-Pierre's approach to security is proactive rather than reactive. He believes in thorough preparation, meticulous planning, and building strong relationships with team members and local authorities. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to quickly assess and neutralize potential threats. What sets him apart is his background in law enforcement, bringing a level of professionalism and expertise rarely seen in the motorsport security field.

Since joining ALL-INKL.COM Münnich Motorsport, Jean-Pierre has implemented comprehensive security upgrades, focusing on preventative measures and emergency response protocols. His ambition is to establish ALL-INKL.COM as the gold standard for motorsport security, ensuring the safety and well-being of every team member and asset.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed, with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is a solidly built man, often seen wearing a serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn copy of the RCMP Criminal Code.
Insists on conducting a full security sweep of the team garage before every race, regardless of how secure it already is.
Has a strange fondness for licorice, which he chews constantly during high-stress situations.
